description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Enduring Courage with haste.
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create a number of Treasure tokens equal to its power.
Activate a Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, both Enduring Courages trigger, giving Kiki-Jiki +4/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer with haste.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Kiki-Jiki and create a number of Treasure tokens equal to its power.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Repeat from step 4.
